name: layer
description: Everything that shows in Layers. The order among siblings is the drawing order: the last one is drawn on top.

visible.description: If false, neither the layer nor its children are drawn.
visible.help: When off, the layer and its children are not drawn.

locked.description: Editor lock: the layer and its children can't be picked or changed on the canvas. It does not change how it looks. It is the user's: the AI does not change a locked layer or its children unless asked, and does not unlock it.
locked.help: Locked layers can't be picked or changed on the canvas.

originX.description: X of the origin: the point the layer's content rotates and scales around, in the layer's coordinates. null = the center of its box. It moves along when the layer's content moves.
originX.help: Origin X: the point it rotates and scales around. Empty = its center.

originY.description: Y of the origin: the point the layer's content rotates and scales around, in the layer's coordinates. null = the center of its box. It moves along when the layer's content moves.
originY.help: Origin Y: the point it rotates and scales around. Empty = its center.
